headline: CV Mimarı launches to simplify ATS-friendly resume creation
summary: This new resume builder aims to eliminate confusing editors and complicated formatting, offering AI-powered improvements and ATS score checking for job seekers.
details: CV Mimarı is a new resume builder designed to make creating ATS-friendly resumes simple, fast, and accessible. It aims to solve the common problems of confusing editors, unnecessary account creation, and complicated formatting that often result in resumes that look good but fail ATS screening.

The tool offers a clean and straightforward interface, focusing on essential features rather than overwhelming users with excessive options. Key features include resume templates, AI-powered resume improvements, ATS score checking, resume optimization, cover letter generation, and PDF export.

The developer is actively seeking user feedback to guide future development. Potential improvements include more resume templates, better AI suggestions, portfolio integration, LinkedIn import, resume version history, enhanced ATS analysis, and international templates.

The goal is to allow users to spend their time improving their experience and qualifications, not fighting with software formatting. CV Mimarı prioritizes ease of use and effectiveness in the job application process.
caption:
